entities.name: Query LpxD
observations: 347 aa; calculated molecular mass 35.41 kDa and theoretical pI 6.83.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt B6ISU1 from Rhodospirillum centenum; identity and coverage 100%, E-value 3.65e-172.
Catalyzes N-acylation of UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine using 3-hydroxyacyl-ACP as acyl donor in lipid A biosynthesis.
Reviewed homologs indicate a homotrimeric enzyme; active-site proton acceptor is position 251 in the exact reference.
Pfam evidence includes LpxD domain PF04613 at positions 35–101 and repeated Hexapep motifs.

entities.name: B6ISU1
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Rhodospirillum centenum annotated as UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine N-acyltransferase.
Catalytic reaction maps to Rhea RHEA:53836; participates in lipid A biosynthesis and bacterial outer-membrane biogenesis.
Annotated homotrimer; active-site proton acceptor at position 251.

entities.name: LpxD acyltransferase reaction
observations: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine reacts with (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[ACP] to form UDP-2-N,3-O-bis[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine, holo-ACP, and H+.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: The protein functions in bacterial lipid A biosynthesis, a pathway contributing to LPS-containing outer-membrane biogenesis.
